title: Microsoft Just Made a $6,000 Box With NVIDIA INSIDE 😳
description:
Microsoft wants $6,000 for a box — here's what's inside. 😳

The Surface RTX Spark Dev Box runs Nvidia's RTX Spark chip: a 20-core CPU, a 6,144-CUDA-core GPU, 128 GB of unified memory and a 2 TB SSD, with up to one petaflop of AI compute (Microsoft claim). Microsoft says its aluminium grid has 1,000 air vents, and it can run AI models of 120B+ parameters locally. $5,999.99 on Microsoft.com (US), shipping in November.

The catch: the Asus ProArt GR1X uses the same chip from $4,499 (with half the memory, 64 GB) — and Microsoft sells just one version.

By our Spec or Wreck score: 58/100 → SPEC. Grab it if you build AI apps all day.
